class.name: RailVehicle3D
class.brief_description: A rail vehicle in the scene - the node it is drawn at.
class.description: The node a rail vehicle is drawn at, and whatever of it rides on that node - a cab, sounds. The vehicle itself is its handle ([method get_rid]); this node takes it ([method set_vehicle]) and hands the servers what the scene set: [RailVehicleServer] places it on its start track, [RailVehicleRenderingServer] draws and moves it. The node does no work of its own per frame. A vehicle assembled by hand names its parts by path - its [VehiclePhysicsNode], its exterior and low-poly models and the submodels of the exterior that move; one built from data hands the servers its handle and appearance itself, and names nothing.

method.name: get_controller
method.description: The controller the vehicle runs on, null before it has one.

method.name: is_editable_in_editor
method.description: Whether the models of the vehicle this node draws stand as nodes in the editor's Scene dock ("Edit FIZ").

method.name: set_editable_in_editor
method.description: Shows the models of the vehicle this node draws as nodes in the editor's Scene dock, to be inspected and edited there, or hides them again ([method RailVehicleRenderingServer.vehicle_set_editable]) - for every vehicle the node draws from now on. A view of the vehicle, not kept by the scene.

method.name: set_vehicle
method.description: Takes the vehicle [param vehicle]: the servers are handed it with what the scene set, and whoever follows this node hears [signal vehicle_changed].

members.member: What a vehicle assembled by hand looks like, beyond the parts its paths name.
The VehiclePhysicsNode a vehicle assembled by hand takes its vehicle from.
The submodel of the exterior that turns as the front bogie.
The submodels of the exterior that turn as the front rolling wheels.
The material the vehicle's head display is drawn with.
The low-poly interior (E3DModelInstance) of a vehicle assembled by hand.

The exterior mirrors in the original's numbering from 1: odd on the left, even on the right. The ones at the end of the occupied cab turn about their vertical axis by [member RailVehicleDoors.mirror_max_shift], as far as their side is unfolded.
The exterior model (E3DModelInstance) of a vehicle assembled by hand; the part paths name its submodels.
The submodels of the exterior that move as the arms of the front pantograph.
The submodels of the exterior that move as the arms of the rear pantograph.
The submodels of the exterior that turn as the powered wheels.
The submodel of the exterior that turns as the rear bogie.
The submodels of the exterior that turn as the rear rolling wheels.
Which way the vehicle stands on its start track.
The track the vehicle is placed on - whichever comes last, the vehicle or the track, places it.
How far along [member start_track_name] the vehicle is placed [m].
The submodels of the exterior that move as the wiper arms.

signal.name: vehicle_changed
signal.description: The vehicle this node draws has changed - it has one now, or a different one.
